tools.name: list_voices
tools.title: List Rime voices
tools.description: List Rime's voice catalog as JSON keyed by model and language: { modelId: { langCode: [speaker, ...] } }. No API key required. Optionally filter by `model` (e.g. 'coda', 'mistv3', 'arcana') and/or `language` (the ISO 639-2 catalog key, e.g. 'eng'), and cap output with `limit` (max speakers per model+language list). Use get_voice_details for demographics and the exact `lang` value to pass to synthesize_speech.

model.description: Filter to a single model id, e.g. 'coda'.

language.description: Filter to an ISO 639-2 language key, e.g. 'eng'.

limit.description: Max speakers per model+language list. Truncated results say how many were omitted.

tools.name: get_voice_details
tools.title: Get Rime voice details
tools.description: Return detailed metadata for Rime voices (gender, age, accent/dialect, country, genre, model, and language). This is where the `lang` value for synthesize_speech comes from, and it carries the demographic metadata you use to choose a voice. No API key required. All filters are optional and applied client-side: `speaker`, `model`, `gender`, `language` (matches either the `language` or `lang` field).

speaker.description: Filter to a speaker name, e.g. 'astra'.

model.description: Filter to a model id, e.g. 'coda'.

language.description: Filter by language; matches the `language` or `lang` field, e.g. 'eng'.

tools.name: check_dictionary
tools.title: Check Rime dictionary coverage
tools.description: Check which words are NOT in Rime's pronunciation dictionary. Returns the list of out-of-dictionary words; an empty list means all words are covered. Out-of-dictionary words still synthesize, but you may want to add custom pronunciations for them. Requires RIME_API_KEY.

text.description: Words to check; separate by spaces, commas, or newlines.

tools.name: normalize_text
tools.title: Preview Rime text normalization
tools.description: Preview how Rime normalizes text before synthesis — exactly what the TTS model will speak. Useful for debugging numbers, dates, phone numbers, currency, and abbreviations. Returns the normalized string. Requires RIME_API_KEY.

tools.name: synthesize_speech
tools.title: Synthesize speech with Rime
tools.description:
Generate an MP3 speech sample from text using Rime TTS, rendered in an inline audio player. All arguments are optional: with none, it plays a default sample in the canonical demo voice (`lyra` on the `coda` flagship model) — the fastest way to hear Rime. Choose `speaker` and `modelId` from list_voices / get_voice_details to try others. The `language` argument is optional: by default it is omitted and Rime infers the language from the speaker (works for English); when provided it is sent as `lang` (e.g. 'eng', the value from get_voice_details). This calls Rime's API and consumes credits, so keep sample text short. Requires RIME_API_KEY.

PLAYBACK: UI hosts render an inline audio player. In a terminal/agent host that can't render the widget, download the returned play URL (also in structuredContent.audioUrl) and play it with a system player — e.g. `curl -s <url> -o /tmp/rime.mp3 && (afplay /tmp/rime.mp3 || ffplay -nodisp -autoexit /tmp/rime.mp3 || mpv /tmp/rime.mp3 || aplay /tmp/rime.mp3)`. Set include_audio=true to also receive a standard MCP audio block for hosts that play audio natively.

text.default: Hi, I'm a Rime voice. This is what I sound like.
text.description: Text to synthesize (max 2000 chars). Omit to play a default sample.

language.description: Optional language; sent as `lang` only if provided (e.g. 'eng'). Omit to let Rime infer from the speaker.

include_audio.description: Also return the audio as a standard MCP audio content block (base64). Enable for hosts that play audio natively; adds the audio to the model's context.

tools.name: generate_integration
tools.title: Generate a Rime integration snippet
tools.description: Generate a ready-to-run code snippet for wiring Rime TTS into a voice agent framework (Pipecat or LiveKit). Returns install commands, code, and .env notes. No network call. Pipecat is Python-only. For LiveKit, `mode` selects 'plugin' (use your own Rime key) or 'inference' (run on LiveKit Cloud, no Rime key).

language.description: Only affects LiveKit; Pipecat is Python-only.

mode.description: LiveKit only: 'plugin' = your own Rime key; 'inference' = LiveKit Cloud.
